title: Tool Calling
text: Tool calling lets an Agent call external tools with structured arguments and use returned data.

title: RAG
text: RAG retrieves relevant context before generation. It reduces hallucination and should cite sources.

title: Eval
text: Eval checks whether an Agent chooses the right action, uses sources, and gives acceptable answers.

title: Memory
text: Agent memory stores useful facts across turns, but should be scoped and editable.
